Scene 1
Effort is based on time spent on the project related to the total amount of salary paid to the individual in a certification period.
In this example, if the employee only worked on this one project for the summer, then they put 100% of their effort on this project.
They could earn $1 or 26.3% of their annual salary, and the effort would still reflect 100%.

More likely than not you are noted as the PI in charge of the project budget the employee is listed under.
If this is incorrect either: (a) the employee was incorrectly charged to your budget or (b) you have been incorrectly identified as the PI on the budget.
In either case, please report the error in SearchLight for our staff to remedy.

ORA utilizes data from MSU Payroll in Banner for effort-reporting certifications. If the data provided doesn’t appear to be accurate, first check with your school's Budget Officer.
If additional help is needed, contact MSU Payroll and/or your Restricted Funds Accountant directly to determine where the salary costs were allocated.
And report the error though SearchLight; ORA staff will re-run the report once any errors are corrected in Banner.
